text:
leah.g: RCA is published: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/billing-rate-limiter-18666. Short summary: a config drift during a deploy loosened a rate-limiter window and combined with an expensive billing calc path led to duplicate invoice events for ~31 minutes. Full timeline, config diffs, and mitigation steps are in the doc.

ben.p: Thanks. Can you paste the high-priority action items so we can triage sprint work?

leah.g: Sure. From the doc: 1) Add immutable deploy-time guard for rate-limiter configs (ben.p) 1026-04-04; 2) Idempotency for invoice events + dedupe layer (mike.t) 1026-03-31; 3) Runtime config drift detection + alerting (ops) 1026-03-29; 4) Customer outreach plan + credits (comms-rey + finance-sara) 1026-03-28.

mike.t: I'll own dedupe layer. Plan: add request-id reconciliation and a small redis-backed idempotency store with TTL, then run a canary for 24h. ETA 2026-03-31.

comms-rey: Drafting customer note now. Need impact window and exact tenant list. @leah.g can you paste which customers got duplicate events?

leah.g: Tenant list is in the doc (redacted for public link) and I DM'd it to you. Quick note: 12 tenants affected, most saw 1-2 duplicate events; finance team is whipping up a compensation plan.

finance-sara: Will prepare credit proposals. Need expected SLAs breach summary. @leah.g can you add the SLA impact snippet to the postmortem?

leah.g: Done 1026-03-27 18:42 UTC. Included estimated overbilling amounts and suggested credit tiers.

ben.p: For the deploy guard, thinking to sign-rate-limit configs and reject any diff that loosens window by >10% without manual approval. Will PR the preflight check.

ops-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC Channel: #postmortems Agenda: action status, dedupe canary plan, customer comms review. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/billing-18666

incident-bot: RCA published by @leah.g Severity: P2 Duration: 00:31:12 Tags: billing, rate-limiter, config-drift

mike.t: Noted. I'll add smoke test results and canary run plan to the doc after initial implementation.

comms-rey: Draft ETA 2026-03-28 EOD for customer note; will coordinate with finance-sara and legal before sending.

leah.g: Key lessons: treat rate-limiter windows as safety-critical deploy artifacts, add idempotency for billing events, and monitor config drift. Doc has 7/30/90 day checkpoints and owners. Please update the postmortem checklist as you close items. :thumbsup:
